confidence_explanation: The user's behavior shows a clear pattern of data exfiltration (multiple downloads) that deviates significantly from their established baseline, including working outside normal hours.

attack_chain.description: User_04 logs in from their normal IP during working hours.
User_04 begins downloading files, exceeding their baseline of 0 downloads per day.
User_04 continues downloading multiple sensitive documents.
User_04 performs a third download, establishing a pattern of data exfiltration.
User_04 logs out after working past their scheduled end time (17:00), indicating off-hours activity.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_04 had a specific business justification or ticket for these downloads.
No information on whether the files were transferred to an external device or cloud storage.
narrative: User_04, a junior accountant with a baseline of zero downloads per day, engaged in a pattern of downloading multiple files from the finance directory. This activity, combined with a logout occurring after their normal working hours, strongly suggests an insider threat involving data exfiltration.
